overview_description.description: Easol is an online platform that develops event and experience software to market and sell bookings. It's e-commerce specially designed for selling experiences and specially designed for experience creators. The platform's competitors in the experiences management space shifted their focus from primarily focusing on their own experiences marketplace to providing more and better tools and broader guidance to their events management customers.

about_short_description.short_description: Easol is an online platform that develops event and experience software to market and sell bookings.

product.name: Websites
product.description: A platform to build and host branded websites with customizable booking journeys for experience businesses.

product.name: Selling & Managing Bookings
product.description: A unified platform to sell and manage bookings for experiences, including tickets, accommodations, transportation, add-ons, and custom packages.

product.name: Payments
product.description: A payment processing system offering flexible payment options including deposits, payment plans, group payments, and multi-currency support.

product.name: Marketing
product.description: A marketing toolset that enables businesses to own customer data, create personalized recommendations, manage promotions, and integrate with analytics tools.

product.name: Easol Capital
product.description: A financing solution offering upfront funding with fixed fees and flexible repayments tied to sales performance for experience businesses.
